notes: Both גַּם particles take the adverbs the ASV wrote for them (*also*, *Yea*); neither is folded into a neighbouring noun or left unrepresented.
The suffixes on צֵאתְךָ and צַעְדְּךָ are the infinitives' subjects and take *thou* (rule 18), the infinitives keeping *wentest forth* and *marchedst*.
Both מִן units head on *out*, the token carrying the ablative lexeme (rule 24).
